stackAssumption: The physical stack has 2.2 um top copper, 6 um LTC-25000, 700 um EME-G730, and no continuous ground plane. Existing BASIC homogeneous microstrip/grounded-CPW equations do not model it. Any numerical results are archived hypothetical grounded-polyimide reference calculations only, not physical-stack predictions; mold resin and ungrounded multilayer CPW are not solved.
